name: github-profile-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the github-profile Hugo shortcode module, proving that the headline strip's metric separators -- especially the note separator's leading space before the private-contributions floor note -- survive Hugo's --minify whitespace collapse. Run against one offline fixture built twice (public/normal and public/minified) from a canned data seam, since the defect this suite pins is invisible without the minified build.
